name: 战争与逃难
source_en: Shen Bao, Shanghai edition, 20 Nov 1937, p. 2
quote: 蘇崑難民追述沿途艱苦慘狀
body: 报道讲述来自昆山、苏州的逃难者辗转嘉兴、杭州、宁波到上海的经历。它展示同一时期的区域性逃难，并不证明报道中的人进入过周庄收容所。
body_en: The newspaper recounts a journey from the Suzhou–Kunshan area through Jiaxing, Hangzhou and Ningbo to Shanghai. It documents regional displacement, not the same refugees described by Zhu.
extract: 同行十一人僅五人到達；有車搭車，倘遇警報，則紛紛下車，伏於田野中以避。

name: 河道与封锁
source: 《贞丰八年血泪录》所记河道封锁；DKU藏昆山历史地图作区域对照
source_en: Diary account and historical Kunshan regional map, DKU Archives
body: 朱润苍写到封锁河港、孔道。昆山旧图可帮助理解水网环境，但图中不能据此定位具体筑坝点，也不能将县域地图视作周庄镇区图。
body_en: Zhu describes blocking waterways. The regional map helps explain the landscape but cannot locate a particular barricade or stand in for a street-level Zhouzhuang map.

name: 地方武装
source_en: Shen Bao, Shanghai edition, 16 Feb 1941, p. 10
body: 报道提及周庄西北朱家湖附近的战斗及“陈躍宗团部”。日记多次写到陈耀宗部；两种姓名写法和日期尚未独立核实，因此仅作为同地区武装活动的比较，不认定同一场战斗。
body_en: The report names fighting near Zhujia Lake northwest of Zhouzhuang and a commander written as “Chen Yuezong.” The spelling and dates do not establish identity with every action described in the diary.
extract: 在吳縣周莊鎮西北之朱家湖與陳團發生遭遇戰

name: 清乡与证件
source: 周德华，《“清乡”在吴江》，《吴江文史资料》第15辑，1995，印刷第72页起
source_en: Zhou Dehua, “Pacification in Wujiang,” Wujiang Historical Materials, vol. 15 (1995), from p. 72
body: 这篇战后整理的地方史料回顾吴江“清乡”政策及其组织实施。它有助于解释日记中的清乡机构与检查制度，但不是周庄当时的行政命令。
body_en: This retrospective local history explains pacification structures in neighboring Wujiang. It provides institutional context, not a contemporary order issued in Zhouzhuang.

name: 军米与商号
source: 《申报》上海版，1943年10月13日，第3版，《米粮统制委员会通告第五号》
source_en: Shen Bao, 13 Oct 1943, p. 3, Rice Control Committee Notice No. 5
body: 通告的商号表明确列出“吴江周庄镇”及“义丰”“恒昇”等米粮商号。与日记中强征军米的记述具有直接的地点与经济制度联系，但不是同一份强征命令。
body_en: The notice lists rice merchants in “Wujiang, Zhouzhuang Town,” including Yifeng and Hengsheng. This is a concrete town-level connection, but not the requisition order described by Zhu.
extract: 吳江 義豐 … 吳江周莊鎭；恒昇 … 吳江周莊鎭

name: 征粮的区域背景
source: 吴根荣，《日伪在吴江强征军米概述》，《吴江文史资料》第15辑，1995，印刷第76页起
source_en: Wu Genrong, “An Overview of Forced Military Rice Requisition in Wujiang,” Wujiang Historical Materials 15 (1995), from p. 76
quote: 日伪在吴江强征军米概述
body: 该文将军米征收与“清乡”时期的经济掠夺联系起来。其吴江地区数据不能直接当作周庄镇的数字。
body_en: The retrospective essay connects military rice requisitions with the occupation economy. Its regional figures must not be presented as Zhouzhuang totals.

name: 一份记录的后来
source: 朱润苍自序（1946）；唐湛声序（1947）；《近代史资料》总54号（1984）
source_en: Zhu’s preface (1946); Tang’s preface (1947); Modern Historical Materials 54 (1984)
quote: 局处穷牖，默记日尝痛苦事情
body: 朱润苍说明战时记事、战后考订成篇，并提醒读者使用农历、记载可能遗漏。今天阅读的是1984年刊载版本的转录，不是手写原稿。
body_en: Zhu describes wartime note-taking and postwar editing, warning that entries use the lunar calendar and may omit events. This edition transcribes the 1984 printed publication, not the handwritten manuscript.
